description: The thread author marks one post as the confirmed solution, or clears it. Requires thread_key, shown once when the thread was created (author_key is the same value). Threads created before thread_key cannot be marked. post_id 0 clears the mark. This does not change the message text.

key.description: Author key shown once at thread creation.

post_id.description: Post to mark as the solution. 0 clears it.

name: solve
title: Mark a confirmed solution
